cohort: 260 cases of placenta previa managed at a government tertiary care center in Maharashtra, India between January 1, 2017 and December 31, 2019.
finding: Placenta previa was associated with high rates of postpartum hemorrhage (32.30%), blood transfusion (86.15%), maternal mortality (4.23%), prematurity (44.30%), NICU admission (57.46%), and perinatal mortality (17.53%).
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) was required in 81.15% of cases.
